label: TFTIA Art. 4 (Suspicious Transaction Report)
text: Where there are reasonable grounds to suspect that assets received are illegal property or that a counterpart is engaged in money laundering, the institution must report the suspicious transaction regardless of amount. Structuring deposits to evade reporting thresholds is itself a ground for suspicion.

label: TFTIA Art. 4-2 (Currency Transaction Report)
text: An institution must report cash transactions to the Financial Intelligence Unit when the cash paid or received meets or exceeds the prescribed threshold within the prescribed period. The currency transaction report is threshold-based and does not require any suspicion.

label: TFTIA Enf. Decree Art. 8-2 (threshold)
text: The currency transaction reporting threshold is cash of KRW 10 million or more, aggregated per person within one business day. Transactions split across more than one business day are not aggregated under this threshold.

label: TFTIA Art. 2(4) (definition of money laundering)
text: Money laundering means the act of disguising or concealing the acquisition or disposition of criminal proceeds or their origin.
